title: Interprocess Data Write
text: Send messages to another processor using interprocessor data write, 1 input, 1 output, {Channels number} sets Select the channel number; {Enable simulation port} enables peripheral simulation port to block, {Circular FIFO depth} sets the number of storage buffers, {Trigger interrupt on receiving core} selects to trigger interrupt and {Participating cores} selects the participating cores of the processor The options vary based on the hardware board you. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable simulation port
params.values: Enable peripheral simulation port to block on (default) | off

params.name: Circular FIFO depth
params.values: Number of storage buffers 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Trigger interrupt on receiving core
params.values: Select to trigger interrupt off (default) | on

params.name: Participating cores
params.values: Select the participating cores of the processor The options vary based on the hardware board you select
